preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 200,000.
The length of string t must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: any(c == 'a' for c in s) and any(c == 'b' for c in t) or any(c == 'b' for c in s) and any(c == 'a' for c in t)
preconditions.description: At least one of the strings must contain at least one 'a' and at least one of the strings must contain at least one 'b'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(n) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{a} {b}' for a, b in operations)
postconditions.description: The output must contain the number of operations followed by the lengths of prefixes to swap.

postconditions.expression: all(c == 'a' for c in s) and all(c == 'b' for c in t) or all(c == 'b' for c in s) and all(c == 'a' for c in t)
postconditions.description: After the operations, one string must consist only of 'a' and the other must consist only of 'b'.
The number of operations must not exceed 500,000.
